title: Deleting the last section or the selected field, long names, live preview
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A template where the last section can be deleted, a field can be deleted while selected, and long field/section names exist.
custom_steps:
1. Delete the last section and confirm the canvas still offers a way to add one back.
2. Delete a field while it is selected and confirm the properties panel clears rather than showing a field that no longer exists.
3. Confirm a very long field or section name is shortened in the canvas, the outline and the properties panel rather than breaking the layout.
4. Change a measurement row and confirm the change is reflected in the preview without republishing.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If the last section is deleted, the canvas still offers a way to add one back.
  • If a field is deleted while it is selected, the properties panel clears rather than showing a field that no longer exists.
  • A very long field or section name is shortened in the canvas, the outline and the properties panel rather than breaking the layout.
  • Changing a measurement row is reflected in the preview without republishing.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9110 (S12 — Template builder authoring); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S12; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-E1: “If the last section is deleted, the canvas still offers a way to add one back”
  • S12-E2: “If a field is deleted while it is selected, the properties panel clears rather than showing a field that no longer exists”
  • S12-E3: “A very long field or section name is shortened in the canvas, the outline and the properties panel rather than breaking the layout”
  • S12-E4: “Changing a measurement row is reflected in the preview without republishing”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
